title: SEC0: Blocked contact check happens after update_read_at commit
description:
In kith-chat/src/message.rs process_update (lines 435-456):

The code commits update_read_at() on line 437, THEN checks if the contact is blocked on line 445. This creates a semantic inconsistency:

If a contact is blocked after update_read_at succeeds but before the blocked check, the receiver's read_at is updated but no receipt is enqueued (correct). However, the read_at update itself may be undesired for a blocked contact.

The fix: Check contact.blocked status BEFORE calling update_read_at, not after. This ensures blocked contacts cannot trigger read_at updates on the receiver's messages.
